posts.title: Automate DL001 chinese hunting camera
posts.description: I recently installed a cheap infrared hunting camera, one of the many clones of the DL001 hunting cameras you can find on AliExpress. It can be powered via 4 or 8 AA batteries or a 6V-2A DC charger, it features an OFF/TEST/ON switch, a tiny screen and a series of beeping buttons that allow you to setup the camera.
